samples.summary: The new date-format control is unreachable from the UI in workspace context, where the documents list that honors it lives
samples.evidence: The new preference lives only on the personal settings route (`App.tsx:114` → `@/app/settings/page`). Inside a workspace the sidebar's Settings entry points at `/w/${workspaceSlug}/settings` (packages/frontend/src/app/Layout.tsx:85, and the same duplicated links in board-detail.tsx:74, docs-detail.tsx:134, notes-detail.tsx:98, slides-detail.tsx:281, document-detail.tsx:203, file-shell.tsx:74), which `App.tsx:109` routes to `workspaces/workspace-settings.tsx` — a page with no theme toggle and no date-format Select. A workspace user therefore sees the Modified/Created columns produced by `useDateFormat()` but has no navigable way to change the preference. Either link personal settings from workspace context or surface the control on the workspace settings page.
searchedFor: read App.tsx routes, Layout.tsx nav builder

samples.summary: Other date surfaces still call formatRelativeTime directly and silently ignore the new preference
samples.evidence: `formatRelativeTime` keeps its old behavior, but its other consumers were not routed through `formatListDate`/`DateCell`, so the preference applies to exactly one table: packages/frontend/src/app/datasources/datasource-list.tsx:160 renders a table 'Created' column with `formatDistanceToNow` directly; packages/frontend/src/components/notifications/notification-item.tsx:47 and packages/frontend/src/app/files/generic-file-view.tsx:41 use `formatRelativeTime`; packages/frontend/src/app/workspaces/workspace-settings.tsx:466 uses `toLocaleDateString`. A user selecting 'Exact date' still sees relative times in the Data Sources list next door. Decide the intended scope and either widen it or narrow the Settings copy (which says 'document lists').

samples.summary: New export `NO_DATE` has no consumer outside its own module (knip unused-export)
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/src/app/documents/document-list-utils.ts:81 exports `NO_DATE`, but the only references are the three internal uses at lines 76, 112 and 127 — no other src file and no test imports it (grep 'NO_DATE' repo-wide returns only that file). knip's frontend workspace (knip.json:17-20, entry `src/main.tsx` + `tests/**/*.test.ts`) reports unused exports, so this is likely to fail that lane; either drop the `export` or assert against it in the utils test.

samples.summary: Lazy Settings route now imports document-list-utils (and thus date-fns), which may add or grow a shared chunk against the enforced budget
samples.evidence: `packages/frontend/src/app/settings/page.tsx:12-14` imports `formatRelativeTime`/`formatExactDate` from `@/app/documents/document-list-utils`, which imports `date-fns` (document-list-utils.ts:1). Settings is code-split (`packages/frontend/src/App.tsx:19`) and previously shared nothing with the documents route, so rollup may hoist document-list-utils + date-fns into a new shared chunk; scripts/verify-frontend-chunks.mjs:180 fails the build on chunk count and 188+ on per-chunk KB. If the sample strings are the only need, inlining two literal examples avoids the coupling entirely.

verdict.reason: The reviewer's factual claims check out: the date-format Select exists only on packages/frontend/src/app/settings/page.tsx:57-86 (routed at App.tsx:114), while workspace context links Settings to /w/:slug/settings (Layout.tsx:83-87, board-detail.tsx:74, docs-detail.tsx:134, notes-detail.tsx:98, slides-detail.tsx:281, document-detail.tsx:203, file-shell.tsx:74) which App.tsx:108-111 routes to workspace-settings.tsx, a page with no theme or date-format control; nav-user.tsx:87-99 offers no /settings link, and home-or-redirect.tsx:25-27 sends workspace users into /w/:slug. However this is not a blast-radius defect: no caller is broken, no export was renamed or removed, no contract changed for existing consumers, and no guard is bypassed. date-format-preference.ts:15 defaults to "relative", the historical rendering, so DocumentList consumers (workspace-documents.tsx:7) behave exactly as before when the preference is never set, and /settings remains a live, working route. What is left is a navigation/discoverability gap whose fix ("link personal settings from workspace context or surface the control on the workspace settings page") is a UI/information-architecture decision — the design-fit lane this lens explicitly defers, and the same shape already pre-exists for the theme toggle (mitigated separately by duplicating it into nav-user.tsx:87). No site outside the diff needs to change for correctness.
